research_mode: official ONS and Home Office web sources only; current release, geography, survey, revision and quality guards; no target parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Crime in England and Wales: year ending March 2026 release
verified_claims: the official release was published on 23 July 2026 at 09:30
the release combines Crime Survey for England and Wales evidence with police recorded crime evidence
the CSEW component is labelled accredited official statistics and the next scheduled release is 22 October 2026
limitations: national release status does not spatially bind a parcel to an LSOA or police force
survey and recorded-crime measures have different coverage and must not be merged into a cardinal parcel safety probability

sources.name: Crime in England and Wales Police Force Area data tables
verified_claims: the dataset release date is 23 July 2026
the current edition is year ending March 2026
the tables contain police recorded crime figures by Police Force Area and Community Safety Partnership area
limitations: PFA and CSP areas are broader than parcels and LSOAs
area totals cannot be assigned to an exact parcel without an explicitly validated geography and methodology

sources.name: Crime in England and Wales annual supplementary tables
verified_claims: the dataset was released on 23 July 2026
the tables provide additional CSEW evidence on experience and perception of crime and antisocial behaviour
limitations: survey estimates are not exact incident counts for a parcel
perception measures must remain distinct from police recorded crime and IoD Crime Domain ranks

sources.name: Crime in England and Wales appendix tables
verified_claims: the dataset was released on 23 July 2026
the current edition covers the year ending March 2026
the tables include CSEW trends and Home Office police recorded crime by offence type with additional detail on violence fraud and antisocial behaviour
limitations: CSEW and police recorded crime are separate statistical systems with different coverage
national and area trends cannot be converted into exact parcel measurements

sources.name: Crime outcomes in England and Wales 2025 to 2026 bulletin
verified_claims: the bulletin was published on 23 July 2026 and covers offences recorded from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026
the fraud and Computer Misuse Act chapter is excluded while City of London Police aligns legacy Action Fraud data with Report Fraud
the bulletin states that first-published case status can change as investigations close and forces submit revised outcomes
limitations: investigative outcomes are not a measure of crime incidence or parcel safety
fraud and cybercrime coverage is incomplete in this release and must not be inferred

sources.name: Crime outcomes in England and Wales technical annex
verified_claims: the technical annex was published on 23 July 2026
timeliness is described as a proxy for investigation efficiency and not a firm measure
the Home Office receives monthly crime and outcome data from police forces and returns identified anomalies or errors for validation or correction
limitations: administrative recording delays can affect measured timeliness
quality assurance does not make area-level data an exact parcel observation
